reviews.text: Waterline Pools is an excellent pool contractor. I am a custom home builder and have worked with the owner, Jon Harrison, for 5 years. He has built approximately 20 pools directly for my customers. I always have and always will recommend Waterline Pools.
reviews.author: Chad Hancock

reviews.text: Waterline built my pool in the spring of 2017. Fast forward 8 years, and I am still very pleased by the design and build quality.  If I ever put in another pool in Dallas, I will be calling Jon.
reviews.author: K Kuykendall

reviews.text: I’ve had several imperfections after redoing my pool. They have not wanted to respond. They left a hose mark in the plaster that did not come out when they refilled my pool after completion. I had a leak in the pool from behind the light which they remove during construction. They became argumentative. I had hard time for them to come out to repair but they did repair it . I would not choose them again for my next pool service project which is sad to say because we both live in the same neighborhood and our children went to school together.
reviews.author: Barlow Irvin

reviews.text: Jon did such a great job on our pool at Cedar Creek Lake.  The whole process was so seamless and the pool turned out beautiful!  We were so happy with this company that we are now having them build our pool in Dallas.  I highly recommend Waterline Pools!
reviews.author: Amy Matthews

reviews.text: We contracted with Waterline Pools late in 2021 for the construction of a pool and outdoor cooking area. Prior to executing the contract, Jon Harrison presented several designs for us to consider all to complement our existing landscape that included Japanese Maples, Little Gem Magnolias and Japanese Yews. The design and components recommended and installed by Jon and his team exceeded our expectations. Waterline took great care in protecting the existing foliage during all phases of the install.  Further and especially important, timely service and support following completion of the project - including replacement of equipment under manufacturer warranty - was excellent.
reviews.author: Wesley Barnwell

reviews.text: Jon and his team did a great job on our pool.  It has been two years since he put our pool in, and we could not be happier with the results.  After everything was installed Jon was available to resolve small issues that I would imagine are common with any newly constructed pool.  I would not hesitate to recommend Waterline to a friend, and Jon would be my first choice if I ever built another pool.
reviews.author: Clay Pulliam

reviews.text:
Jon and his team at Waterline were a referral from our neighbor and came exactly as advertised:
Timely, attentive, competitive on pricing and high quality pool restoration work. We were very impressed with the final result and excited to use it for the summer!
reviews.author: Courtney Carrabine

reviews.text:
Concrete pad developing pits/holes where debris and water collect. Plaster color lacks conformity. Did plasterer mix appropriately? Final check by Jonathan completed? Was told color would smooth out over time…did not happen. No response from Jonathan on the matter. He bullied me into making the final payment before plastering. Now I know why- final product is not good. Beware.
Update- 02/25/2023- Jonathan came by today and educated me a bit on the conformity of the pool mentioned above. He assured me that in time that will even out. If it does not,  he would acid wash the pool for me to get it the way it should be. The holes in the concrete will be repaired (not a big deal). I do appreciate the effort he is putting in to make sure I am happy with the end product. Thank you.
Update- Jonathan was notifying pool cleaning company to service my pool. Never was contacted.
I had another pool company come out and they told me the plaster was not done correctly. For my issue to be resolved will take years and years to magically wash away, if at all. That was another gut punch during this whole ordeal. I feel I was taken advantage of.
Update: 08/20/2024- Pool was re-plastered. No issues anymore. When the plaster contractors repaired the pool they dropped acid on a concrete pad. The concrete pad contractors were unable to match the damaged concrete pad color to the other pads. One pad out of the 5 pads is whiter than the others.
reviews.author: Roger Carroll

reviews.text:
I shopped around a lot looking for a pool builder and I'm very happy with what Hayden and his team provided.

Whenever there was an issue or I had a question, I just texted Hayden and within a few minutes I would get back a reply.

My build was not an easy build. Champagne spa, water/sewage/gas reroute, burying an electrical line, and a giant wall with a built in TV and waterfalls. I asked Hayden a few times if he felt comfortable building this and he'd always reply with he could build whatever we wanted.

It turned out great. Yeah some issues came up every now and then. Building a pool, remodeling, etc. is a messy process. What matters is that your builder is quick to respond and has a path forward to make you happy.

At one point they installed some glass tile and the thinset wasn't thick enough so you could see all the markings beneath the glass tile. Huge bummer. So, Hayden and his team ripped out all the glass tile and completely replaced it. This was not a trivial cost and they ate 100% of it.

Remember, when you're shopping for a pool, you're shopping the builder as much as you are the pool. Any builder can show you beautiful pools they may or may not have built. I want someone that I can easily get ahold of, is known in the Dallas area, and is super knowledgable should any issues arise.

If you're still shopping for a builder, I definitely recommend Waterline. I wouldn't say they're the cheapest, but I've had friends go with the cheapest and it's not fun. Waterline gives excellent value.
reviews.author: Alex McGregor

reviews.text: The most amazing and fun experience I have had in a long time. Jon Harrison and his staff went above and beyond our expectations, just like his company slogan states. We started with a clean slate of ideas and not knowing exactly what we wanted in a pool. I had my own vision and Jon added his experience and talent to combine to build us an amazing pool. Jon was great dealing with the city and all the compliances we had to go through. Jon's crew (Frank), are master craftsman at what they do. Hands down the best in the DFW area. His crew was always on time and pleasant to deal with and they always answered my questions. Jon really helped in selecting the right tile, stone, plaster, and style of waterfalls we wanted. He understood my vision and he executed it and delivered exactly the way I had it in my mind. Jon will walk you through every detail and keep you posted daily of what the next step is. He makes it so easy. If you are searching for your dream backyard and your dream pool, Jon Harrison will make this happen. Thank you Jon for all your hard work and creating a beautiful pool for us.
reviews.author: Darren McBride

reviews.text:
Excellent craftsman for the plaster. Decent work on the tile though attention to detail was lacking. Prep work team was outstanding.

On the downside, Jon doesn't listen real well. At the end of the job, he made it very clear that rather than offer to repair things like tile issues and correcting a problem with the original installation of skimmers, Jon took the attitude that it wasn't his fault, it wasn't in the scope of the contract, and he was much more interested in collecting his last payment. I wasn't asking for free repairs, but Jon's lack of listening skills missed that.

It's also a bit hard to be impressed with a company who's owner shows up to sell his services wearing worn out sweatpants and a ragged t-shirt. For the money a pool costs to renovate, I'd like to see the owner show up in at least business casual. His sub-contractors literally dressed better than he did. A small thing but to me it says something about awareness of details.

I'd definitely recommend his sub-contractors. Not so much Jon. My last impression of him was not favorable. I ended up fixing the tile and skimmer issues on my own. For that kind of money, I'd like to see him take ownership for the entire pool instead of what was strictly in the contract. Perhaps you'll have better luck with him.
reviews.author: Neil Reid

reviews.text: 4 years ago Jon & his team of craftsman installed our salt water pool. Its a testament to his skill in selecting the quality products used, and the skilled work of his craftsmen, that our low maintenance pool is as beautiful today as the year is was built.
reviews.author: John Dale

reviews.text: Can’t say enough about this company. From start to finish they always kept me in the loop and when faced with any challenges I was thoroughly impressed with the professional response. I can’t image going another year without a pool in Texas. I also added the hot tub which is freaking amazing.!!!  If you’re thinking of doing this, do it!!!!
reviews.author: George Howard

reviews.text: Jon and the team are excellent. Wonderful working with them and the team. We would highly recommend Waterline!!
reviews.author: Justin Brauer

reviews.text: Great experience!  Very professional crew that arrived on time and completed the job within the stated timeline.  Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Andy Harder

data.summary: Reviews appear highly authentic with a clear pattern: Waterline Pools delivers quality design and construction but shows inconsistency in post-completion defect resolution and communication, particularly after final payment. The 45-year history, A+ BBB rating, and detailed project descriptions in reviews support legitimacy. Negative reviews focus on specific defects and response issues rather than scams or abandonment.
fake_signals: Low review volume (19 Google, 7 Yelp) for a 45-year-old company could indicate low engagement, but not necessarily fake reviews

negative_evidence: No response from Jonathan on the matter (plaster color)
They have not wanted to respond (hose mark in plaster)
Refused to correct tile issues and skimmer problem
positive_evidence: After everything was installed Jon was available to resolve small issues
They did repair it (leak behind light)

authentic_signals: Specific project details (e.g., 'Japanese Maples', 'Champagne spa', 'water/sewage/gas reroute')
Varied writing styles and perspectives (homebuilder, homeowner, remodel customer)
Mix of praise and specific constructive criticism
Emotionally authentic language in both positive and negative reviews
data.discrepancy_explanation: Google (4.6) and Yelp (3.9) ratings are directionally consistent, showing a generally positive but not perfect contractor. BBB A+ rating with no complaints aligns with a reputable business. The single Houzz 5-star review is not statistically significant.
